subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Pentacarbonylchromate（[Cr(CO)₅]²⁻）？
A. Trigonal bipyramidal
B. Square pyramidal
C. Tetrahedral
D. Linear
explanation: Trigonal bipyramidal. Covalent count: Cr (group 6) 6 e; 5 × CO (L) 10 e; the 2− charge adds 2 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 2− charge, so the metal is Cr(−II), d⁸; d⁸ + 10 e from the ligands = 18 e.
